import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

# Assuming the following API functions are available:
# add_symptom(name, description)
# get_symptom(name)
# update_symptom(name, description)
# delete_symptom(name)
# has_symptom_in_consultation_requests(name)

@pytest.fixture
def mock_api():
    api = MagicMock()
    api.add_symptom = MagicMock()
    api.get_symptom = MagicMock()
    api.update_symptom = MagicMock()
    api.delete_symptom = MagicMock()
    api.has_symptom_in_consultation_requests = MagicMock()
    return api

def test_add_new_symptom(mock_api):
    mock_api.add_symptom.return_value = True
    assert mock_api.add_symptom("SymptomName", "SymptomDescription") == True

def test_view_symptom_details(mock_api):
    mock_api.get_symptom.return_value = {"name": "SymptomName", "description": "SymptomDescription"}
    symptom = mock_api.get_symptom("SymptomName")
    assert symptom["name"] == "SymptomName"
    assert symptom["description"] == "SymptomDescription"

def test_update_symptom_details(mock_api):
    mock_api.update_symptom.return_value = True
    assert mock_api.update_symptom("SymptomName", "UpdatedDescription") == True

def test_delete_symptom_no_consultation(mock_api):
    mock_api.has_symptom_in_consultation_requests.return_value = False
    mock_api.delete_symptom.return_value = True
    assert mock_api.delete_symptom("SymptomName") == True

def test_delete_symptom_with_consultation(mock_api):
    mock_api.has_symptom_in_consultation_requests.return_value = True
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        mock_api.delete_symptom("SymptomName")

@pytest.mark.parametrize("symptom_name, symptom_description", [
    ("SymptomName", "SymptomDescription"),
    ("AnotherSymptom", "AnotherDescription")
])
def test_add_multiple_symptoms(mock_api, symptom_name, symptom_description):
    mock_api.add_symptom.return_value = True
    assert mock_api.add_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description) == True

@pytest.mark.parametrize("symptom_name, symptom_description", [
    ("SymptomName", "UpdatedDescription"),
    ("AnotherSymptom", "UpdatedDescription")
])
def test_update_multiple_symptoms(mock_api, symptom_name, symptom_description):
    mock_api.update_symptom.return_value = True
    assert mock_api.update_symptom(symptom_name, symptom_description) == True
